# Roman History - History of Humanity

> > Comprehensive resource on Roman history from the Kingdom of Rome through the Byzantine Empire, featuring detailed biographies of emperors, dynasties, and pivotal events.

This site provides scholarly reference material on Roman emperors, political crises, settlements, and cultural developments spanning the Principate, Severan dynasty, and imperial succession periods. Coverage includes major figures like Julius Caesar, Marcus Aurelius, and the Julio-Claudian dynasty, as well as lesser-known rulers and critical transitions in Roman governance.

## Key Topics

- Roman Empire
- Byzantine Empire
- Julius Caesar
- Augustus Caesar
- Marcus Aurelius
- Principate Period
- Roman Republic
- Kingdom of Rome
- Severan Dynasty
- Imperial Rome
- Julio-Claudian Dynasty
- Year of the Four Emperors
- 3rd Century Rome
- Roman Emperor Biographies
- Imperial Succession

## Major Roman Emperors & Leaders

- [People | Julius Caesar](https://romanhistory.historyofhumanity.org/people/julius-caesar): Biography of Julius Caesar and related Roman emperors of the Principate

## Imperial Crises & Dynastic Transitions

- [Cultures | Year of the Four Emperors](https://romanhistory.historyofhumanity.org/cultures/year-of-the-four-emperors): Imperial succession crisis of AD 68-69 following Julio-Claudian dynasty

## Settlements & Cultural Context

- [Settlements | Greek Settlements](https://romanhistory.historyofhumanity.org/settlements/greek-settlements): Ancient Greek settlements and their role in Roman historical context

## Principate Period Emperors

- [Roman Emperors | Didius Julianus](https://romanhistory.historyofhumanity.org/people/didius-julianus): Biography of Emperor Didius Julianus from the Principate period

## Optional: Minor Emperors & Usurpers

- [Roman Emperors | Diadumenian](https://romanhistory.historyofhumanity.org/people/diadumenian): Biography of Diadumenian, Severan dynasty co-emperor in 3rd century Rome
- [People | Marcus Aurelius Marius](https://romanhistory.historyofhumanity.org/people/marcus-aurelius-marius): Brief reign of usurper emperor Marius in Gallic Empire, 269 AD
